song-home-on-the-range.title: Home On The Range
how: We pick silly words for the song!
Point to a picture for each word.
Then we sing it with our silly words!
song-home-on-the-range.lyrics:
Oh, give me a home where the {buffalo|things} roam,
Where the {deer|things} and the {antelope|things} play,
Where seldom is heard a discouraging word
And the skies are not {cloudy|describe} all day.

[Chorus]
Home, home on the {range},
Where the {deer|things} and the {antelope|things} play;
Where seldom is heard a discouraging word
And the skies are not {cloudy|describe} all day.

song-five-little-pumpkins.title: Five Little Pumpkins
how: We pick silly words for the song!
Point to a picture for each word.
Then we sing it with our silly words!
song-five-little-pumpkins.lyrics:
Five little {pumpkins|things} sitting on a {gate},
The first one said, "Oh my, it's getting {late|describe}!"
The second one said, "There are {witches|things} in the air!"
The third one said, "But we don't care!"

The fourth one said, "Let's run and run and run!"
The fifth one said, "I'm ready for some fun!"
Then whoosh went the {wind}, and out went the light,
And the five little {pumpkins|things} rolled out of sight!
